build_RluAtari_dataset: build an RLU Atari dataset builder instance with a specific builder config for a game and run
create_features_dict: create a features dict describing the RLU Atari dataset schema via get_features_dict
get_dataset_description: get the description and citation metadata for the RLU Atari dataset
